# Museumtips — calendar feeds

Auto-generated iCalendar (`.ics`) feeds of current **temporary exhibitions at Dutch museums**,
refreshed weekly (Thursdays). Shows get countdown labels as they approach their end
(`Last month:` -> `Last 3 weeks:` -> `Last 2 weeks:` -> `Last week:`) plus a `Last day:` marker.

**Do not edit the feed files by hand** — they are regenerated and overwritten automatically.

## Subscribe

| Feed | URL |
|---|---|
| All exhibitions | `https://museumtips.pepperlink.nl/museumtips.ics` |
| Closing soon (<= 30 days) | `https://museumtips.pepperlink.nl/closing-soon.ics` |

- Apple Calendar: tap the subscribe buttons at <https://museumtips.pepperlink.nl/> (or File -> New Calendar Subscription).
- Google Calendar: Other calendars -> "+" -> From URL -> paste the link.
